scope: Verified lossless storage reclamation for the runtime import acceptance campaign. This adds no compatibility passes. Current managed tools, stock engines, original source/tests and result logs are unchanged.

archives.scope: Reclaim extracted large LLVM files used only by paused custom-Bun engine research. Their exact ordinary files remain recoverable from the retained official LLVM archive; verify every selected member and source before removing its redundant extracted copy. Current managed application tools, stock engines, Lean originals and all test results remain unchanged.
archives.restore: Before resuming custom Bun builds, extract only each named member from the retained official tar.xz archive back beneath .cache/bun-build-tools/llvm, verify original SHA256 and length, and restore the recorded mode and mtimeNs. Keep the archive immutable.

archives.scope: Lossless archival of large generated intermediate files from paused custom-Bun engine research. Five completed baseline lifecycle Wasm/native caches are included after their campaign and follow-up input controls released. Current managed application toolchains, stock engines, original Lean/Bun sources and all test results remain unchanged. Restore these files before resuming their historical builds.
archives.restore: Decompress each archive to its original path, verify originalSha256 and size, then restore recorded mode and mtimeNs. Archive files remain immutable.
